bias_note: Lean: bearish to neutral NQ into Friday. Relative weakness vs ES/RTY is the theme. AMZN AMC decides the overnight. A strong AWS print with contained capex could gap NQ up and run today's buy-side (the Thursday high / the GOOGL-gap open). A capex-heavy AWS miss extends the AI ROI sell-off toward the Globex lows. Fri 8:30 AM ECI is the only red folder left; a hot print with the 10Y near 5% backs a hawkish Fed. Iran headlines move oil, and oil moves yields. Month-end flows Friday. Next week: AAPL Mon AMC, then ISM and NFP.

takeaway: NQ lagged all day: the Nasdaq was ~-1.7% into the last hour while the S&P was ~-0.65%, the Dow ~-0.6% and the Russell +0.7%. It was a rotation out of mega-cap tech and software, not broad risk-off. GOOGL is down ~13% (worst day ever, ~$500B of market cap gone) on AI capex and negative free cash flow. Software was crushed: NOW -25%, FTNT -21%, IGV -4%. MSFT gave back its premarket pop (~-0.6%). Strong data (GDP 3.4%, core PCE 3.1% y/y, claims 194K) keeps December hike risk alive. The 10Y eased to ~4.99% and WTI to ~$102 on Iran diplomacy, which softened the drop. VIX is calm at ~16.8. AMZN and INTC report after the close and set Friday's NQ open.
